data.long_meaning: Milivoj is a Slavic name derived from the elements 'mil' (gracious) and 'voj' (warrior, soldier). The name signifies a gracious gift from God to a warrior or soldier. In Slavic folklore, it was believed that gods granted their favors to warriors before battles, ensuring their success and protection. The name Milivoj carries the meaning “Gracious Gift of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Slavic. Parents who choose Milivoj usually hope their child will grow to embody gracious gift of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
